```plato

    // The same ring walked the other way round. A face built around a vertex
    // winds opposite to the rotation that generated it, so the operators that
    // emit one vertex-face per vertex take this order to keep every face of the
    // result wound counter-clockwise from outside.
    ReversedVertexCornerRing(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertex: VertexIndex): Array<CornerIndex>
    {
        var ring = self.VertexCornerRing(vertex);
        return ring.Count.MapRange(i => ring[ring.Count - 1 - i]);
    }
```
